notes.title: Stuck in the room with the mirror
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone[/b], 
-I noticed that several players were stuck in the room with the mirror without knowing what to do, there was a chandelier with a pull in the middle of the room, [u]I added a switch at the entrance to the room[/u]
- Minor bug fixes
